title: AO/329/2014 of United India Insurance Company Ltd. AND ANOTHER Vs Smt Sureshi Devi AND OTHERS

paras.text:
AO No. 321 of 1998 (Old Number)
 329 of 2014 (New Number)
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate for
the appellants.
Mr. Niranjan Bhatt, Advocate for
the respondent No. 1.
Respondent Nos. 2 & 4 have died.
Respondent No. 3 has not been served
but his interest is common with
respondent No. 1.
Looking to the oldness of the
appeal, the Court is inclined to dispose
of the same.
The award was passed by the
Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal in
Claim Petition No. 64 of 1996 for the
amount of Rs.1,23,600/- and this
amount was deposited by the Insurance
Company in compliance of the order of
the Honíble Allahabad High Court in the
instant appeal. Later on, the appeal
transferred to this Court for disposal.
Learned counsel for the
respondent No. 1 has apprised the Court
that two deaths had occurred in the
questioned accident and the award was
passed separately to the dependants of
deceased persons. One appeal (AO No.
320 of 1998) has failed on merits.
Having heard learned counsel for
the parties, the Court does not find any
force in this appeal and it is hereby
dismissed but at the same time, the
Court modifies the operative portion of
the impugned judgement to the effect
that the rate of interest as 15%, as
awarded by the Tribunal is, struck off.
